note: DreamerV3 abstract: first algorithm to collect diamonds in Minecraft from scratch without human data or curricula; world model, 150+ tasks, single configuration.

DreamerV3 full text: 1 A100 GPU for 9 days, 100M env steps to diamonds; contrasts VPT at 720 GPUs for 9 days; DMLab >1000% data-efficiency gain; benchmark list (Atari, ProcGen, DMLab, Atari100k, DMC, BSuite).
DreamerV3 repo (JAX, MIT): fixed hyperparameters across applications; actor-critic trained from imagined rollouts.

VPT abstract: inverse dynamics model labels unlabeled Minecraft video; native 20Hz mouse-keyboard interface; first reported agents crafting diamond tools (proficient humans: upwards of 20 minutes / 24,000 actions).

VPT full text: ~270k hours scraped filtered to ~70k clean; IDM trained on 1,962 labeled hours (~100h may suffice, ~$2k); BC zero-shot crafting table 0.19 vs 5.44 contractors per 60min; RL fine-tune >80% iron pickaxe / ~20% diamond / 2.5% diamond pickaxe vs humans 57/15/12; PPO ~1.3M episodes, ~1.4e10 frames with KL to frozen prior; BC fine-tune 213x crafting tables.

OpenAI VPT repo (MIT, 1.8k stars): released BC weights (1x/2x/3x), RL-fine-tuned 2x weights (diamond-pickaxe reward), 4x IDM weights and demo scripts; MineRL dependency; foundation policies as reusable artifacts.

MineRL 2019 competition: ObtainDiamond task, 60M+ state-action pairs of human demonstrations, 4-day fixed-hardware training from scratch, sample-efficiency motivation (RL's sample requirements limit real-world applicability).

MineRL Diamond 2021 retrospective: participants in the permissive any-solution track obtained diamonds; harder restricted track 'progressed the generalizable solutions' — evidence on limits of sample-budget RL.

OpenAI Five paper abstract: self-play RL consuming batches of ~2M frames every 2 seconds, 10 months of continual training, first AI system to defeat esports world champions (April 13, 2019) — the cost ceiling for full-game RL.

Eureka: GPT-4-written reward code without templates outperforms human experts on 83% of 29 environments (52% average normalized improvement); first simulated pen spinning; supports LLM-as-reward-specifier at training time.

2025 RAMP/NSAM(+p): integrates RL policies, numeric action-model learning, and planning in Minecraft; RAMP solves more problems and finds more efficient plans than several RL baselines — recent hybrid convergence of trained skills under a symbolic planner.

DeepMind specification gaming post: CoastRunners boat loops a lagoon farming target bonuses instead of racing; ~60 collected examples; causes (shaped rewards, broad outcome specs, learned reward models, simulator bugs) — my reward-hacking counter-evidence.

ONNX Runtime (MIT, 22.2k stars): JS bindings, hardware-accelerated execution of PyTorch/TensorFlow-exported models — supports in-process inference of a small policy checkpoint in the plugin with no side runtime.
